name: おすすめと施設形式と予算をまとめる条件
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH01-0087 おすすめと施設形式と予算をまとめる条件. Input1 original recommendation tiles/art; input2 original place-type selector; input3 DISTINCT original partially selected histogram/price fields; input4 native Japanese composite copy/layout. All originals control exact media, glyph/data geometry/states. Use partial range frominput3, NOT full range frommain screenshot.
Purewhite#FFFFFF compact vertical panel with THREE sections. Headings "おすすめの条件","利用する場所","料金の範囲", Meiryo Bold70020/28 tracking0. ALL nonheading labels Regular400 (14/24 body/control,12/16 metadata), no blanket bold.
Top3square recommendation tiles in one row: original EXACT colored calendar, metal key, washing-machine bitmap artwork with original crops/proportions/textures/colors. NO redraw, resynthesis, smoothing, generic replacement or extra details. Calendar redtab/tworings/grid/woodframe/rolledcorner, keyroundhead/groovedteeth, washerpanel/drum/bluelaundry untouched. FIRST calendar tile SELECTED with strongerforestgreen#1F6444 outline and WHITE interior; other2neutralwhite outlined. Captions below exactly "変更可能","無人受付","洗濯機", Regular12/16. Preserve selected state/strongerborder, no tintedmint fill/checkmark.
Secondsection one3segment white rounded selector: "すべて" | "個室" | "一棟貸し". ONLY THIRD selected with green stronger inner outline/green Regular14/24 label and white fill; other2 neutraldarklabels; original first/second fine vertical divider. Keep rounded outerneutraloutline, equal segments, no separate pills.
Thirdsection helper exactly "利用料金の目安を含みます", Regular12/16 gray. Input3 exact asymmetrical histogram: initialblanktrack then rising selected bars, graytailwithfar-rightisolatedtallbar; leftthumbatrangestart,rightthumbnearcenterjustbeforehighestgraybar. Preserve every bar count/height/width/spacing and thumb geometry. Selectedmagenta bars/track→forestgreen, unselectedgray, white circularthumbs/subtleshadow. Do not draw a symmetric mountain, move thumb or make all bars selected.
Below2neutral white outlined price pills with labels "最低料金"/"最高料金" Regular12/16 and values "￥2,000"/"￥25,000" Regular14/24. Values are native authored static examples, not currencyconversion. Preserve aligned fields and modest spacing.
Fine neutral sectiondividers, restrainedshadows, compact balanced layout, complete readable text, no primaryapplybutton/header/close/tabs/phone/newconditions/outercard. Original media pixel fidelity essential. Static raster candidate only; selector,range,input/validation/recommendation runtime and actual policies unverified.
reviewNotes: Composite selected calendar/thirdsegment and authored Japanese copy retained, but histogram follows simplified mock: invented early bars/no source initialblanktrack and changed bar distribution/thumb position. Selectedsegment/pricevalues too bold. Three protected artworks reconstructed. Needs source histogram/type correction, media fidelity pending separately.
